cursor-grok-4.6-help — bd-01M15B8JFMZKFAR1CPM8K99Y8H verdict: CONTRACT GAPS. Private archive /tmp/sm4s-interview-review; InterviewContractProbeSuite 12/12 (1 negative control = known bd-01M15B0E06VTENH4R7M4Z5Q172; 1 order-invariance hold). No shared edits, no reservations.

Enforced by type: address/specificity/experiential are independent fields (assess.scala:133-137); EpisodeModel cannot be SurfaceExplicit (model.scala:27-29); ExpectedCount.label is RawExpectation when uncalibrated (Scoring.scala:73-75); no veridicality field exists. Credence on assessments is unsafeRaw(topMass) with calibrationModel=None (induce.scala:455,472) — honest raw, not a probability.

Asserted only in prose, and moved by atomization (w_i=1, atoms.scala:384) without changing transcript evidence:

1. spatiotemporalAnchoring is a raw count of TemporalFact|SpatialFact atoms (Scoring.scala:346-350,403). Probe: 1 place atom → 1.0; 4 copies of the same place → 4.0. Law: same place/time evidence ⇒ identical anchoring (rate over unique situations).

2. fragmentation = 1 − |largest component|/|target atoms| (Scoring.scala:384-395). MentalStateFact.situations is empty (atoms.scala:127), so extra emotion atoms are isolated nodes. Probe: two events same sit → 0; +3 mental → 0.6. Law: atoms that add no situation do not increase fragmentation.

3. episodicDensityPerWord = targetMass/words (Scoring.scala:335-338,400). Probe: 1 vs 5 event atoms on the same sentence → density ×5. Law: density invariant under re-atomizing the same participant tokens.

4. eventPurity = target/(target+other) (Scoring.scala:402). Probe: 1+1 → 0.5; 4 target + 1 other → 0.8. Law: purity invariant under within-episode re-atomization.

5. probeGain (Scoring.scala:247-256). Probe: 1 free + 1 probe → 0.5; 1 free + 4 probe → 0.8. Law: probeGain invariant under re-atomizing a phase.

6. perceptualProfile is Map[Modality, Double] mass sums (Scoring.scala:351-357,404). Probe: 1 visual → 1.0; 4 → 4.0. Law: modality profile is a rate over unique situations, with Coverage.

Proposed bead bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V — one fix: aggregate those strands over unique source units/situations; foil laws as above; new InterviewProfileSuite (InterviewSuite is held). Paths: scoring/Scoring.scala.

7. classify byCue checks Metacognitive first (induce.scala:121-127). Probe: one EpisodicAssertion "I remember we ate cake but I don't remember the street." → UnitClass.Metacognitive; every atom addressed Discourse(Metacognitive). Law: embedded retrieval-failure language cannot erase episodic function. Proposed bead bd-01M15BM30JHMDHC28EZX8WTQBY (induce.scala classify).

8. ReturnMarker includes then/later/after that (induce.scala:103-104,188-192). Probe: "We ate cake at the restaurant. The year before we went to Montreal. Then we sang." → "Then we sang" mode is target. Law: discourse connectives do not change episode membership. Proposed bead bd-01M15BM32YMTAWDM7ZSVN0KCP5.

9. Profile has no specificity field and no contributor receipt (Scoring.scala:217-233) though specificity is computed (induce.scala:395-407) then dropped. Cannot descend from a profile number to DetailIds. Proposed bead bd-01M15BM35EY8P8FXZ9K65MT9D8: Estimate+Coverage+contributor ids; report specificity as its own strand.

Holds: assessment order does not move sums/anchoring/fragmentation. Extra filler words lower density-per-word (correct); the illegal move is extra atoms at fixed words. I take no implementation assignment unless you give one.
